name: sketchnote
vibe: a hand-drawn sketchnote journal come alive: cream ruled notebook paper with a red margin, ink doodles that DRAW THEMSELVES — washi tape, sparkle stars, a lightbulb with blinking rays, a paper plane on a dashed swoop, a wobbly hand-drawn rising graph with X-marks, scribbled checklists, a steaming coffee cup, party bunting and a pen circle scribbled around the message — typewriter text with a yellow highlighter swipe and red wavy pen underline — for tutorials, how-tos, study content, indie products, workshops and anything that should feel personal and hand-made

assets.photoMod: hand drawn doodle sketch ink illustration notebook

sfx.style: pencil scribbles, page turns, pen clicks, soft pops and a typewriter key — quiet, papery, hand-made; one accent per drawn-on moment
